item.title: Thermogenic beige fat protects blood vessels from hypertension
item.description: Obesity causes hypertension. Hypertension causes cardiovascular disease. And cardiovascular disease is the leading cause of death worldwide.

item.title: Bio-engineered skin grafts offer new hope for severe burn injuries
item.description: Bio-engineered skin grafts can play an important role in the treatment of burn victims. Researchers at the University of Zurich have been working on new approaches for such grafts for over 15 years.

item.title: Incretin-based diabetes drugs show potential protective effects against dementia
item.description: A large McGill University study has found that two classes of medications commonly prescribed for Type 2 diabetes, both incretin-based, are associated with a reduced risk of dementia.

item.title: New blood biomarker tracks brain injury progression after ischemic stroke
item.description: A new blood marker reflects the extent of brain injury after an ischemic stroke and can predict patient outcomes months to years later.

item.title: LI-COR's Carbon Node named “Internet of Environment Solution of the Year” in 2026 IoT Breakthrough Awards program
item.description: LI-COR announced today that its Carbon Node is the recipient of the "Internet of Environment Solution of the Year" award in the 10th annual IoT Breakthrough Awards program conducted by IoT Breakthrough.

item.title: INTEGRA launches lab evolution automation competition
item.description: INTEGRA Biosciences is inviting labs to leave manual pipetting behind and take their first steps into effortless automation with a new Lab Evolution competition for 2026.

item.title: Formulatrix® and Spear Bio advance automated ultrasensitive protein detection through ongoing partnership
item.description: Formulatrix, a leader in laboratory automation solutions, and Spear Bio, an innovator in ultrasensitive protein biomarker detection, today announced their ongoing partnership to automate and optimize the SPEAR UltraDetect™ assay platform using the F.A.S.T.™ (Flow Axial Seal Tip) Liquid Handler.

item.title: Kaiser Permanente to pay $556 million in record Medicare Advantage fraud settlement
item.description: In the largest Medicare Advantage fraud settlement to date, Kaiser Permanente has agreed to pay $556 million to settle Justice Department allegations that it billed the government for medical conditions patients didn't have.

item.title: Study connects adolescent exercise with breast cancer risk biomarkers
item.description: Recreational physical activity may be associated with breast tissue composition and biomarkers of stress in adolescent girls, according to a new study from Columbia University Mailman School of Public Health and the Herbert Irving Comprehensive Cancer Center (HICCC).

item.title: Sapio Sciences announces partner ecosystem for ELaiN, its third-generation AI lab notebook
item.description: Sapio Sciences, the science-aware™ AI lab informatics platform, today announced the availability of trusted, third-party scientific applications and platforms now integrated directly into Sapio ELaiN, its third-generation AI lab notebook.
